question: How does the consciousness principle manifest its many forms without losing unity?
premises: One space gleams as white, blue, and red without ceasing to be one space.
Clouds appear in many ways while arising in that same space.
The autonomous consciousness principle vibrates forth in its own forms beyond construction and enumeration, yet those forms are not anything separate from it.
inference: Multiplicity of appearance does not compromise the unity and autonomy of the consciousness principle.
plain_english: Just as one space gleams as white, blue, and red, and just as clouds appear in many ways, so the autonomous principle of consciousness vibrates forth in many ways through its own forms, beyond construction and enumeration—and yet those forms are not anything separate from it.
